items.title: Coinbase Lays Out Hot Wallet Controls as Customers Ask if a Binance-Style Hack Could Hit It
items.summary: Customers asked whether Binance’s Oct. 29 breach could happen at Coinbase. The exchange pointed to signing keys that are never reassembled, caps on refilling hot wallets and switches that can pull keys offline.

items.title: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish on Coinbase Stock?
items.summary: Coinbase has underperformed the broader market. However, Wall Street sentiment remains cautiously optimistic, with analysts leaning toward a recovery.

items.title: Strategy Is Down 45% From Its High. Saylor Sees “the Next Bitcoin Bull Market”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysStrategy is down 45% from its high a year ago after bitcoin fell below what it paid for its coins and its STRC preferred stock slipped under $100, a slide that also hit MARA Holdings and Coinbase. Executive Chairman Michael Saylor says the next bitcoin bull market has begun, but Strategy’s bitcoin per share is down 3.

items.title: Solana Foundation payments lead: Banks will hold cash on-chain
items.summary: Solana Foundation payments lead Jamal Raees says bank deposit tokens like JPMorgan’s JPMD will win the corporate treasury, while stablecoins from Circle and Tether will keep the global rails they need to move.
